title: Fix business-day arithmetic across two modules
goal: Fix shop.schedule and shop.sla so business-day counting and due dates follow the documented rules.
acceptance_criteria: is_business_day is False on Saturday, Sunday and on any holiday
business_days_between(start, end, holidays) counts business days in [start, end) (start included, end excluded) and returns 0 when start >= end

due_date(start, n, holidays) returns start when n == 0; otherwise the date after n further business days (start itself is never counted, even when it is a business day), and raises ValueError for n < 0
holidays may be any iterable of dates (list, set, tuple)
